intro.title: Tiger Eye Necklace Mala
intro.descriptionHtml: Wide range of Tiger Eye Necklaces which are strung in different patterns and making options. Tiger’s Eye is one of the highly revered gemstone since ancient times. It is known as an ‘all-seeing all-knowing eye,’ and is believed to grant the wearer the ability to observe everything. It is also known to attract luck and steady in-flow of money. Tiger’s Eye helps to overcome fear that grips one during public performances, competitions, and exams. It brings focus and stability and helps the wearer to make rational decisions rather than emotionally scrutinizing the situation and taking irrational decision.
